hints: When does a given machine hear the message? Phrase that as a question you already know how to answer.
At the earliest total delay along any route from the source - which is the cheapest-route question, with delay in place of toll.
One run of the same algorithm settles every machine, not just one. Do not stop early; let it finish.
The answer is then the largest of the settled times - and `-1` if any machine was never settled at all.
